title: miRNA-34a-5p is a novel biomarker and modulator of the radioresponse in esophageal adenocarcinoma.
snippet: Poor pathological response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (neo-CRT) remains a major clinical challenge in esophageal adenocarcinoma (EAC), contributing to treatment resistance and poor patient outcomes.
